{YR|2n./EeA5Q~GXSE(f.text:
This creates a text at a certain width. This is great for intro templates because it allows everyone's username to be seen on the screen.

Clone ID: The Clone ID you want those letters to have
X: The X position of the text
Y: The Y position of the text
Width: The width of the text  (the screen is 480 width, I usually do 400). 
Font: Comfortaa: 1, Londrina Solid: 2, Bungee: 3, Baloo Palij: 4, American Captain: 5
Alignment: (L, C, or R) C is usually what you want to use. 
Text: The text you want to type. (Could be the username block)

a}7bH1khUe%Vq`/}DsRe.text:
Various Variables:

• Clone ID: Clone ID, If you don't understand this, check out @MathMathMath's tutorial. 
• Costume #: Doesn't matter, it's used in the Size and Position hacks. 
• Letter #: This is the letter # of the letter. For example, if I was typing "twonerds", the letter # of t would be 1. 
• Letter Costume #: This is the costume number of the letter. When the letter starts as a clone, put a switch costume to (Letter Costume #)
• Letter Size: This is the size of the letter. When the letter starts as a clone, put a Set Size (Letter Size) custom block. 
• Letter X/Letter Y: This is the X Position and Y Position of the letter. When the letter starts as a clone, put a Go to (Letter X)(Letter Y) custom block. 
• Text Length: The length of the text. For example, if I was typing "two", the text length would be 3. 
• Text Width: The specific width of the text
